summary: CWE-606: the bad entry point parses an integer directly from an untrusted request cookie (request.getCookies()[0].getValue()) and uses it as the upper bound of a for loop with no validation, allowing an attacker-controlled value to drive an unbounded/negative loop. The fix validates the parsed value against a sane range before it is used as the loop condition, clamping out-of-range values to a safe default while still honoring legitimate numeric cookie values within range.
